messages.content: [system prompt omitted to save space — identical rendering rules as run2-t0.5, prompt revision before the Sunday-hours sentence]
Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
I strained my lower back and the pain is intense. Can you see me today?

If this is an emergency, please hang up and call one-one-nine for an ambulance right away. If it's not an emergency, I can answer questions about booking a visit. Would you like to know our hours and how to make an appointment?
No, it's not bad enough for an ambulance.

I'm glad to hear that. We're open today until seven PM, and you can book an appointment online through our website. Would you like to arrange for a staff member to call you to help with booking instead?
Got it, thank you very much.
